title: Gemini in Google Search

body.text: Google Search has integrated Gemini in the form of
AI Overviews, which summarize an answer at the top of the search results
, so you get an answer right away without clicking into different websites.

example: "Search: 'easy sourdough bread for beginners' and notice the AI Overview at the top."

title: How do AI Overviews work?

body.text: gather information from multiple sources and synthesize a comprehensive answer
, with citations you can click to verify — great for questions that need several perspectives.

example: "Search: 'pros and cons of remote work' and look at the AI Overview summarized from several sites."
